posts.title: Force-quitting apps saves battery

slides.text: Force-quitting apps saves battery
THE TRUTH — Idle apps barely drain the battery. It's screen brightness and the one app hammering the CPU that actually cost you power.
Share this with the person who still believes it.

posts.title: Ops rules that prevent the worst outages

slides.text:
Ops rules that prevent the worst outages
Set budgets and alerts before you build

Set budgets and alerts before you build
Cap autoscale and scale dev to zero
Tag everything at creation, never later
Test restores monthly — 'success' isn't proof
Make infra code so it's reviewable and rollback-able
Save this — insider knowledge only pays off when you use it.

posts.title: Remove junk and bloatware safely

slides.text:
Remove junk and bloatware safely
Settings > Apps > Installed apps
Settings > Apps > Installed apps
Uninstall trialware and toolbars you never open
Run Disk Cleanup afterwards to free the space
For stubborn apps, use their own uninstaller first
Never download 'PC cleaner' tools — they cause more harm than good.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

The Honor Watch 6 Pro is going on pre-sale today – Honor is offering it at promotional prices and with cool early bird perks.
Note that the euro prices below apply to France, Germany, Italy and Spain.
